sources.snippet: The Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct Large Language Model (LLM) is an instruct fine-tuned version of the Llama-3.2-3B. NVIDIA NIM offers prebuilt containers for large language models (LLMs) that can be used to develop chatbots, content analyzers—or any application that needs to understand and generate human language.
